landing.heroSubtitle: AI-powered Japanese learning platform designed for foreign workers in Japan. From JLPT preparation to specialized nursing care Japanese.
landing.featureAiTutorDesc: Practice conversation with an AI tutor that adapts to your level and provides instant feedback.
landing.featureJlptDesc: Comprehensive study materials and mock exams for all JLPT levels from N5 to N1.
landing.featureKaigoDesc: Specialized courses for nursing care and healthcare Japanese used in real workplace scenarios.
landing.featureMultilingualDesc: Learn with explanations in your native language. Supporting Vietnamese, English, Chinese, and more.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Choose the plan that fits your learning style
landing.testimonial1Quote: Thanks to NihonGO!, I passed JLPT N2. Being able to learn nursing care terminology in real scenarios is very helpful.
landing.testimonial2Quote: The AI tutor teaches like a real teacher. It corrects mistakes instantly, so I can improve efficiently.
landing.testimonial3Quote: I can study on my phone during my commute, so I can keep learning every day even when busy. It's fun like a game!
landing.faq1A: Yes, the Free plan is completely free. You can take up to 3 lessons per day and use basic AI tutor features.
landing.faq2A: We support all JLPT levels from N5 (beginner) to N1 (advanced). The AI automatically provides learning content tailored to your level.
landing.faq3Q: Can I learn nursing care terminology?
landing.faq3A: Yes, you can learn specialized Japanese used in care facilities and hospitals through scenario-based learning. Content is supervised by active nurses.
landing.faq4A: We support 6 languages: Vietnamese, English, Chinese, Indonesian, Tagalog, and Myanmar. Grammar explanations are displayed in your native language.
landing.faq5A: Yes, we offer bulk license plans for companies. Progress tracking features for learners are included. Please contact us for details.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start for free. No credit card required.

pricing.title: Pricing Plans
pricing.subtitle: Choose the perfect plan for your learning journey
pricing.upgradePrompt: Upgrade to continue learning without limits
pricing.billingFaq1A: All paid plans are billed monthly. You can cancel or change your plan at any time from your account settings.
pricing.billingFaq2Q: Can I change my plan later?
pricing.billingFaq2A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and billing is prorated.
pricing.billingFaq3A: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through our secure payment processor Stripe.
pricing.billingFaq4A: The Free plan lets you try NihonGO! with 3 lessons per day at no cost. No credit card required to get started.
pricing.billingFaq5Q: How do I cancel my subscription?
pricing.billingFaq5A: You can cancel your subscription anytime from the Manage Subscription page. You will continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
